'''Elwinn Taron''' is the [[Wisdom]] of [[Deven Ride]]. 

==Appearance==
She is plump, with a pleasant and motherly smile. She is short. She wears her hair braided in the [[Two Rivers]] style.

==History==
She does not have the [[Talent]] of [[Listening to the Wind]].

==Activities==
She, [[Milla al'Azar]], [[Daise Congar]] and [[Edelle Gaelin]] meet with Faile to discuss events in the Two Rivers. They find talking to Faile easier because of the unexpected effect Perrin's ''ta'veren'' ability has on their resolve. 

She offers to have a dress made for [[Faile]] by a [[Taraboner]] seamstress who has settled in Deven Ride. The woman had previously made dresses that Elwinn considered indecent for women who were not married or courting.
